checks: Empty state and a first board persist title, an exact collection snapshot and an explicit reason
Pending and invalid item forms block navigation/export and keep IME DOM, input and caret
One area accepts at most nine items; editing/reordering preserves reason and source at capacity
Nine independent areas work as an overview and selected area grid, then reopen unchanged
JSON and standalone HTML preserve chosen content; import creates explicit detached copies and rejects hidden fields
Atomic storage failure retains current DOM/caret; retry and a real two-tab conflict preserve both complete versions
Local board operations preserve existing posts, drafts, collection and exact original bundle
Input during delayed save acknowledgement uses the real saved baseline; conflict-copy read locks inputs and races leave no partial copy
